sentences.en: The ambulance broke down in the middle of the avenue.
sentences.zh: 救护车在大街中间抛锚了。

sentences.en: They explored every avenue in an attempt to avoid war.
sentences.zh: 他们想尽一切办法试图避免战争。

sentences.en: There are many avenues in this leafy part of town.
sentences.zh: 在这个绿树成荫的区域有很多途径可以选择。

senses.zh: 途径, （城镇的）大街, 林荫道（尤指通往大住宅者）, 选择
